name: Progressively Deblurring Radiance Field (PDRF)
definition: A novel approach to efficiently reconstruct high quality radiance fields from blurry images by incorporating 3D scene context into blur modeling and using an efficient importance sampling scheme for fast optimization.
summary: Progressively Deblurring Radiance Field reconstructs high-quality radiance fields from blurry images by incorporating 3D scene context into blur estimation and using efficient importance sampling for fast optimization.
